prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one fine-line plate for the heritage collection Fanggu. Image 1 is LINE STYLE ONLY, the Vairocana contour master. Image 2 is SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY. Create a refined sparse BLACK INK line drawing on perfectly flat opaque PURE WHITE #FFFFFF. Match elegant delicate thin organic contours, restrained internal detail, generous white surfaces. No fills, shadows, grey shading, crosshatching, grain, paper texture, gradients, halos or checkerboards. Door recesses are outlines, not black blocks. Show the selected subject complete and centered with 8% margins, verticals vertical and minimal perspective; photograph fixes identity and proportions. Remove tourists, trees, foliage, vehicles, wires, signs, clutter and sky. No letters, calligraphy, labels, captions, border or watermark. TWELVE eave/storey tiers of the stepped red wooden pavilion against a narrow rock backing. Nine lower historic tiers plus three smaller upper tiers added in 1956. Keep circular windows and narrowing outline, only a compact strip of supporting rock; no trees, river, embankment or bridge. Portrait 1024x1536, subject about 82% of height.
